name: Kaptin Slystabba

bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: Kaptin Slystabba may use Ruin Actions, and has 3 personal Ruin.

bonuses.name: Blood Axe
bonuses.text: This Threat gains +2 bonus dice to Leadership (Wil) and Stealth (A) Tests.

abilities.name: Sneakiest Git
abilities.text: During the first round of combat in which Kaptin Slystabba ambushes his opponent, he makes the following Multi-Action with no penalty: Slystabba makes an Interaction Attack using Stealth (A). If he succeeds, the target is Restrained. Slystabba uses his Intimidatin' Action. Slystabba makes an attack.

abilities.name: Intimidatin'
abilities.text: Kaptin Slystabba makes an Interaction Attack using Intimidation (Wil). If he succeeds, the target also suffers Fear.

abilities.name: Get 'Em Ladz!
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin. All allies with the ORK Keyword within 10 metres gain +1 bonus dice to Ballistic Skill (A) and Weapon Skill (I) Tests.

abilities.name: Kunnin' Exfiltrator
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin. Slystaba takes the Fall Back Combat Action and may move up to double his movement, then make a Stealth (A) Test to hide.

abilities.name: Hit & Krump!
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin. If Slystabba used Kunnin' Exfiltrator and successfully hid from all enemies, he may use the Sneakiest Git Battlecry.
Once per Round, Slystabba may make an attack with his Big Choppa as a Reflexive Action.

note: No Tier row printed; class proposed (Champion with 3 personal Ruin). Print: Intimidation skill printed as "(5)" in brackets, stored as 5 dice, no Passive; "Slystaba" once in the Ruin text.
